description: Synthetic band sessions with an answer key. GENERATED by scripts/make_band_fixtures.py from synapse_device.codec / synapse_device.consumer; nothing here is a measurement. `recv_ms` is the phone's monotonic reception time since the start of the recording.

raw.name: clean_20s
raw.description: 20 s of ECG, PPG, ACC, GYRO and MAG, no loss: 20 R waves, 60 bpm.

raw.name: ecg_frames_lost
raw.description: Three consecutive ECG frames (sequences 4, 5, 6) never reach the phone.

raw.name: band_restart
raw.description: The band reboots during the ECG stream after 80 frames: sequence and device clock start again. A restart is followed, not counted as thousands of lost frames.

raw.name: timestamp_wrap
raw.description: The device microsecond counter wraps 2**32 three seconds into the ECG and PPG streams.

raw.name: device_reported_loss
raw.description: The band reports samples it dropped (frames 2 and 5 of the PPG stream): 7 and 255.

raw.name: invalid_frames
raw.description: Valid ECG frames mixed with six that must be refused and counted, never interpreted.

raw.name: repeat_and_late_frame
raw.description: A repeated frame and a late one: both are counted apart and neither moves the counter back. The late frame was counted missing when its successor arrived (the rule does not retract), and neither extra frame adds samples to the timeline.

l1.name: l1_session_120s
l1.description: 120 s of feature frames: 2 lost at 20 s, a band restart at 90 s, one frame of an unknown version, a warm-up with sentinels.
